_comment: entropy_threshold selects the tagger checkpoint watermark/ie/model/entropy_tagger_<tau>.pt — set 0.9, 2.2, or 3.5 (all three are shipped). Larger tau = fewer watermarked tokens: measured TPR@0.1% 0.985 / 0.910 / 0.601. Set "output_tag" (e.g. ie_t2.2) when you change entropy_threshold, so each run writes its own corpus.
